theme: Clean Light Theme (विशिष्ट स्वच्छ लाइट थीम)
emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 4 (Organic Trust, Local Festival/Event Chanda Ledger, Precision & High-Legibility)

responsive.breakpoint: mobile-first (default <640px phone view with expanded support for sm, md, lg, xl)
responsive.layout: Mobile sticky bottom navigation tab bar + top header with quick action trigger. On tablet/desktop (md+), side navigation or wide responsive bento cards.
responsive.typography: Mobile-optimized text sizes: H1 clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 2.25rem), H2 1.35rem, Body 1rem (16px to prevent iOS input zoom), Labels 0.875rem (14px). Heavy weight numerals for currency ₹ values.
responsive.overflow_guard: w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden to prevent horizontal scrolling on small viewports.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 48px x 48px interactive touch targets for all buttons, inputs, selects, and filter chips, with 12px+ padding for high non-technical accessibility.

typography.heading_font: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif (Bold, clear, authoritative yet warm)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, sans-serif (Highly legible, crisp Indian English & Hindi support)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For transaction IDs, amounts, dates, receipt numbers)

scale.currency_large: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-emerald-700 font-mono

colors.base_theme: Clean Light Theme with vibrant warmth (Creamy Off-white background, High-contrast Charcoal text, Emerald Gold accent)

visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0) with soft layered ambient shadow (shadow-sm md:shadow-md), rounded-2xl corners, padding p-4 sm:p-6.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Large tactile buttons (h-12 or h-14), rounded-xl, font-semibold, active scale feedback (active:scale-[0.98]), visible focus rings.
visual_enhancers.quick_amount_presets: Chip buttons for popular Indian Chanda sums: ₹101, ₹251, ₹501, ₹1100, ₹2100, ₹5100 with 1-tap fill.
visual_enhancers.status_badges: Pill-shaped rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold with distinct light background and strong text contrast.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Warm friendly illustration/icon states, encouraging Hindi/English subheadings, big clear CTA to 'Add First Chanda'.

grids_and_layouts.container: w-full max-w-md sm:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 pt-4 pb-28 md:pb-12
grids_and_layouts.mobile_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 flex justify-around items-center shadow-lg
grids_and_layouts.form_layout: space-y-5 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

shadcn_overrides.button: Ensure min-height 48px, rounded-xl, high contrast focus states.
shadcn_overrides.input: Height 48px, text-base (prevents iOS auto-zoom), border-slate-300 focus:border-teal-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-100.
shadcn_overrides.select: Large select items with min 44px tap area, non-transparent popover background bg-white.
shadcn_overrides.dialog_drawer: Use Vaul Drawer / Shadcn Sheet on mobile for smooth bottom-sheet modals, sliding up naturally.
shadcn_overrides.tabs: Full width equal segment tabs with h-auto py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl active tab in high contrast teal/dark.

custom_features.collector_field: Dual Mode: Combines a quick-select Dropdown of saved collectors with an 'Add New Collector' free-text input field.
custom_features.currency_input: Automatic ₹ prefix, numeric keyboard default input mode, instant total calculation.
custom_features.quick_status_toggle: 1-click toggle directly in Chanda List to switch status between Pending and Collected without entering edit mode.
custom_features.export_modal: Column Picker checkbox matrix (Name, Amount, Collector, Payment Mode, Status, Date, Receipt #) before exporting to PDF, Excel (XLSX/CSV).
custom_features.backup_restore: JSON file download backup + file upload restore with preview & confirmation step.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, lightweight PWA-ready Chanda / Donation Collection Management Web App for single-user offline-capable management.

Include 5 key tabs in the Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar & Top Header: 1. Dashboard (डैशबोर्ड), 2. Quick Add (चंदा जोड़ें), 3. Chanda List (चंदा सूची), 4. Reports & Export (रिपोर्ट्स / एक्सपोर्ट), 5. Settings & Backup (सेटिंग्स / बैकअप).
Use ₹ (INR) currency formatting with Indian grouping (e.g. ₹1,50,000) across all summary metrics.

DASHBOARD REQUIREMENTS: Total Expected, Total Collected, Total Pending KPI metric cards with status indicator bars. Collector-wise summary breakdown chart/cards. Payment Mode (Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, Other) breakdown chart/cards. Quick stats and recent 5 entries.

ADD CHANDA FORM: Donor Name, Amount (with ₹101, ₹251, ₹501, ₹1100, ₹2100, ₹5100 quick chips), Collector (dropdown list + freetext custom option), Payment Mode (Cash/UPI/Bank Transfer/Other), Status (Collected/Pending - default Collected), Date (date picker or today button). Auto-generates receipt ID.

CHANDA LIST: Search bar (searches name, collector, receipt ID), Filters (Status: All/Collected/Pending, Payment Mode, Collector, Date Range), Sort (Date desc/asc, Amount desc/asc), Quick Status Toggle button, Void Entry button (with confirmation modal), Edit Entry modal.

REPORTS & EXPORT: Column selector checkboxes (Name, Amount, Collector, Payment Mode, Status, Date, Notes/Receipt). Export triggers for PDF receipt list print layout, Excel (CSV/XLSX downloader), and Printable Ledger sheet.

SETTINGS & BACKUP: Manage Collectors list (Add/Remove default collectors), Backup data export (download JSON file with timestamp), Restore data import (upload JSON file with data validation & replacement/merge options), Reset data option with double confirmation.
MOBILE-FIRST COMPATIBILITY: Ensure all inputs are >=16px text size to prevent mobile iOS zoom. Navigation must stay sticky at bottom on mobile devices.

DATA PERSISTENCE: Use LocalStorage for instant persistence so data remains intact across page refreshes, offline usage, and PWA sessions. Pre-populate with 8-10 realistic demo entries (e.g. Ramesh Kumar ₹501, Anita Sharma ₹1100, etc.) so the app looks populated immediately on first load.

TESTING ATTRIBUTES: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, status toggles, export buttons) MUST include precise kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-dashboard-tab', data-testid='add-chanda-submit-btn', data-testid='chanda-search-input').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Clean Light Theme is required: DO NOT use dark mode as default background. Keep crisp white surfaces with warm slate and emerald accents.
Do NOT center align the main application container globally.
Do NOT use universal CSS transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-opacity.
DO NOT use emojis as primary icons (e.g. no 🤖🧠💭). Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react standard icons.
Always provide data-testid on every interactive element.
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Chanda added successfully! ₹501 from Ramesh', 'Backup downloaded', 'Entry voided').
